{{Image}}
'''Homing cluster missiles''', also called '''seeker cluster missiles''', were [[Cluster missile/Legends|cluster missiles]] that possessed the capability of homing in on singular targets such as large [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] or even several enemies at once. They can be further upgraded into the [[Homing cluster missile|advanced homing cluster missiles]].
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)}}
During the [[Attack on Thyferra]], while defending the bacta tanks from Moff Seerdon's forces, Rogue Squadron proceeded to destroy a nearby bunker and retrieved the seeker cluster missiles.
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
During the space portion of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]],while targeting two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyers]] in order to hold off the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]], spotted a container of homing cluster missiles underneath the leftmost [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and procured them.
{{Endgame}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike}}
In the ground portion of the same battle, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and two [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] shortly after hijacking the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] [[Tempest Scout 2/Legends|Tempest Scout 2]], managed to procure another container of homing cluster missiles.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
'''Homing cluster missiles''' were a recurring tech upgrade in the ''Rogue Squadron'' series of games. They were generally found during at least the penultimate levels of each installment, if not the final levels.
